movie_title: What chickens can teach us about hierarchies - 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English!  
Humans work together all over

vocabulary.definition: a way of organizing people or things in different levels of importance
vocabulary.example: In the company, the hierarchy consists of bosses, managers, and workers.

vocabulary.definition: to stop or prevent something, such as productivity, from happening
vocabulary.example: The super-chickens suppressed the productivity of the rest by killing them.

vocabulary.definition: a hierarchy of status or importance, especially in a group of people or animals
vocabulary.example: In the chicken coop, there is a clear pecking order with the dominant chicken at the top.

vocabulary.definition: the measure of how much work is completed by a person, machine, or organization
vocabulary.example: The productivity of the team increased significantly after implementing the new software.

vocabulary.definition: to establish or apply something, such as a rule or restriction, in a forceful or unwelcome way
vocabulary.example: The manager imposed strict deadlines on the project team.

vocabulary.definition: a group of birds, especially domesticated birds like chickens
vocabulary.example: The flock of geese flew in a V formation across the sky.
